info.title: Tavily Search and Extract API
info.description: Our REST API provides seamless access to Tavily Search, a powerful search engine for LLM agents, and Tavily Extract, an advanced web scraping solution optimized for LLMs.

post.summary: Initiate a web mapping from a base URL
post.description: Tavily Map traverses websites like a graph and can explore hundreds of paths in parallel with intelligent discovery to generate comprehensive site maps.

requestBody.description: Parameters for the Tavily Map request.

url.description: The root URL to begin the mapping.

instructions.description: Natural language instructions for the crawler. When specified, the cost increases to 2 API credits per 10 successful pages instead of 1 API credit per 10 pages.

max_depth.description: Max depth of the mapping. Defines how far from the base URL the crawler can explore.

max_breadth.description: Max number of links to follow per level of the tree (i.e., per page).

limit.description: Total number of links the crawler will process before stopping.

select_paths.description: Regex patterns to select only URLs with specific path patterns (e.g., `/docs/.*`, `/api/v1.*`).

select_domains.description: Regex patterns to select crawling to specific domains or subdomains (e.g., `^docs\.example\.com$`).

exclude_paths.description: Regex patterns to exclude URLs with specific path patterns (e.g., `/private/.*`, `/admin/.*`).

exclude_domains.description: Regex patterns to exclude specific domains or subdomains from crawling (e.g., `^private\.example\.com$`).

allow_external.description: Whether to include external domain links in the final results list.

timeout.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for the map operation before timing out. Must be between 10 and 150 seconds.

include_usage.description: Whether to include credit usage information in the response.`NOTE:`The value may be 0 if the total successful pages mapped has not yet reached 10 calls. See our [Credits & Pricing documentation](https://docs.tavily.com/documentation/api-credits) for details.

base_url.description: The base URL that was mapped.

results.description: A list of URLs that were discovered during the mapping.

response_time.description: Time in seconds it took to complete the request.

usage.description: Credit usage details for the request.

request_id.description: A unique request identifier you can share with customer support to help resolve issues with specific requests.

400.description: Bad Request - Your request is invalid.

401.description: Unauthorized - Your API key is wrong or missing.

429.description: Too Many Requests. Error messages and retry delays can vary by rate-limit rule.

432.description: Key limit or Plan Limit exceeded

500.description: Internal Server Error - We had a problem with our server.

RetryAfter.description: When present, the number of seconds to wait before retrying. Read the returned value; the delay can vary.

bearerAuth.description: Bearer authentication header in the form Bearer <token>, where <token> is your Tavily API key (e.g., Bearer tvly-YOUR_API_KEY).
